name: Hartland
description: The first major settlement of the world.

name: Old Town
description: This historic district of Hartland is known for its density and architecture.

name: Downtown
description: This contemporary district of Hartland represents the economic center of the city. The tallest towers and biggest ambitions can be found here.

name: Barad Dûr
description: This historic Hartland tower has been retrofitted as a hub for the Netro project.

name: St. John’s Bridge
description: Based on Portland’s famous St. John’s Bridge, the Hartland St. John’s Bridge connects downtown Hartland to the Netro hub.

name: Bee Dome
description: This early build brings warmth into Hartland with its massive glass dome. Inside the dome, bees are hard at work tending to this lush garden.

name: Community Greenhouse
description: Built to supply the snowy region with the ability to farm, the Old Town garden is a unique piece of Hartland history.

name: Clock Tower
description: The Old Town clock tower was built to orient people to various cardinal directions.

name: Enmieas Central Bank
description: The bank building was started by businessman and politician Richard Enmieas. Currently, the abandoned shell of the building sits abandoned.

name: Breshan
description: Originally a defensive compound, the suburb of Breshan grew into the second largest settlement in the world.

name: Costco
description: This big box store was built to facilitate trade at an industrial scale once the bank system was put in place. However, with the bank project stalled, the store remains empty and abandoned.

name: Hartland Transit Center
description: Built by IMI, the Hartland Transit Center connects the nether roof transit with the overworld ice boat lines as well as a large ghast port.

name: Erskine
description: This unincorporated settlement was started by the CEO of Enemies Central Bank. This settlement found itself the subject of controversy after disallowing new buildings within its borders.

name: City of Varese
description: This city is the furthest populated area of its size from Hartland. Varese stands adjacent to one of the largest oceans in the world.
